blurb: Riverside Golf Club offers an 80-year-old, mature 18-hole golf course open to the public seven days a week. Guests can dine at the Riverside Bistro & Rooftop Bar with indoor and outdoor seating overlooking the 18th hole. The club also provides event hosting spaces including an outdoor pavilion and a bistro dining room, as well as an RV park for lodging.
extraNote: All alcoholic beverages must be purchased through Riverside Golf Club · Venue pricing varies by time of year, party size, and day of the week · No outside food or beverage allowed
